I had seen a dream some 10 years back.At that time my parents had gone for hajj.I was suffering from maleria with high fever and body pain.My brother, sister and uncle were at home.After dinner we all went to sleep, I was having very high pain in my body & i was not able to sleep. I was lying on the bed and suddenly i saw two men dressed in all white coming towards me, they greeted me and started talking to me and inquired about my health. i told them about my fever and body pain.They sat close to my legs started massaging my legs, i was feeling very comfortable and they pain just vanished. all the time they were talking to me but i dont remember what exactly they were talking but they made me feel very comfortable.i forgot every thing about the pain and was talking and laughing with them. Then all of a sudden I heard a sound calling my name,it was my uncle who was waking me up.When i opened my eyes The 2 person were not there. I asked my uncle about the 2 person & he told me that i must have seen a dream but i could not believe it because it was so real. But i could not recollect the faces of the 2 persons. Please tell me the tabeer of this dream. 1781 views Q. خواب 1153 views Q. Please give a nice tabir my parents are waiting to get both of us married soon before Ramadan inshallah. 1529 views Q. my mother saw a dream that she is carryin a pot full of milk for makin tea but then she comes to know that theres some fly or insect in it,, after some time she saw small lizard in milk and she thinks not to use the milk .please give tabeer to my dream? 2075 views Q. میرے دوست نے مجھ کو IESامتحان (سرکاری امتحان)دینے کا مشورہ دیا۔ میں نے ایک ہفتہ تک استخارہ کیا۔ چوتھے دن رات میں تقریباً ایک بجے کے قریب میں نے خواب دیکھا کہ میں ایک کار چلا رہا ہوں، سامنے قطار میں شیطان کھڑے ہیں ۔ ان میں سے ہر ایک روڈ پر مجھ کو پکڑنے کی کوشش کرتا ہے لیکن میں ان میں سے ہر ایک سے بچ جاتا ہوں۔ اس کے بعد اچانک ایک دیوار یا درخت کے سامنے آتا ہوں اور اچانک میری آنکھ کھل جاتی ہے۔ میں نے اپنی آنکھیں کھولیں۔ میں نے دعا پڑھی اور دوبارہ سو گیا۔ 1496 views Q. Asalamu 'alaikum, Today something strange happened. After salat al Fajr, I read some Qur'an and then decided to go back to sleep. I had my mobile phone in my hand to set the alarm clock. All of the sudden, I think I went into a dream, where first my legs started elevating and I could not bring them down. As far as I can remember, I saw one of my teachers saying to me that saying "Allahu Allahu", basically constant dhikr (like tasawwuf ones) is sinful and maybe she said that is the case if it done at home. Certain things happened afterwards in the dream but I cannot remember. Then my eyes opened and the mobile phone was still in my hand and I looked at the time to find that it was only about 20-25 mins after my eyes closed. This is the 2nd time dear respected one, that this has happened to me. The first time it was also after fajr and reading Qur'an and also lasted about the same time as the second one- although the content of the dream was different. Could you please explain? Jazak Allahu Khair. 1936 views
